description: Shiller's CAPE: the price over the average of real earnings over a window, its earnings yield and the excess CAPE yield over a real 10-year rate.

cpi.description: The price index of each period of the window
cpi.title: Cpi

earnings.description: Earnings of each period of the window before month t, oldest first (Shiller: the previous 120 months)
earnings.title: Earnings

inflation.description: Trailing annual inflation to take from the nominal yield; left out, (price_cpi / cpi[0]) ** (periods_per_year / n) - 1 over the window
inflation.title: Inflation

nominal_yield.description: A nominal 10-year yield, less trailing inflation for the real rate; give this or real_yield
nominal_yield.title: Nominal Yield

periods_per_year.description: Periods a year of the window (12 for months)
periods_per_year.title: Periods Per Year

price.description: The index level in month t
price.title: Price

price_cpi.description: The price index (CPI) of month t, the dollars results are in
price_cpi.title: Price Cpi

real_yield.description: A real 10-year yield (TIPS); give this or nominal_yield
real_yield.title: Real Yield

title: Cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio (CAPE): inputs
